main.description: Get the requester's appearance setting. Requires auth. A community member is served, ready or not; anyone else gets NotEnrolled unless includeRetained finds a setting kept for it.

includeRetained.description: Also answer a setting kept after the requester stopped being a member, marked retainedUntil; served to the requester whether or not it is a member now. Without it, a kept setting is not answered.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView, and has no kept setting (or did not ask for one with includeRetained).
